# Cosmos Hub live RPC fixture

Captured on 2026-09-25 from the public Cosmos Hub (`cosmoshub-4`) RPC service:

- [Block 33121486](https://cosmos-rpc.publicnode.com/block?height=33121486)
- [Results at the same height](https://cosmos-rpc.publicnode.com/block_results?height=33121486)

The [Cosmos chain registry](https://github.com/cosmos/chain-registry/blob/master/cosmoshub/chain.json)
listed this public endpoint at capture. No credential was sent. One empty head
block and one bounded 20-height metadata window were read to locate this
transaction-bearing block; only this block and its results are retained here.

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `block.json` | `cf93c5a7eee0528ebcb2335c73ad4c13fb7f779ed16c345fde71a1f44cdf6b7c` |
| `results.json` | `d17c80bc3effa3227d8887b455aa8f456a7f206fa7f60e37f1dbe0707dc68a54` |
| `tx.pb` | `b45b7cc06acdfa304476ffd296777abfa06cba15ed58b36c769dd6b48b897073` |

`tx.pb` is the exact base64-decoded first transaction from `block.json`.
These are public on-chain data, including transaction and validator identities.
Neither JSON response is generated by the mapper. See
[the qualification record](../../../../docs/audit/510-cosmos-values.md) for the
independent wire decoder and Parquet comparison. The minimal v2 replay is
generated locally from these RPC responses; it is not a captured Firehose
payload and does not qualify that provider's transport or producer integration.
